overview: Italy is a very attractive country for students interested in the chemical processes, industrial production, materials, pharmaceuticals, energy and environmental sustainability. Its universities combine basic science with engineering applications, laboratory learning and opportunities to examine advanced industrial technologies.

In Italy, undergraduate studies in Chemical Engineering in Italy generally last three years and award a first-cycle university qualification. Students learn about chemical substance processing, industrial plant operation and how to make production systems safer, more efficient and environmentally responsible.

Edu-Hawk Worldwide can help Indian students planning to study abroad after Class 12 to explore suitable universities, know admission requirements, prepare documents and navigate the application process. Before applying, students are advised to carefully check the language of instruction, entrance-test requirements and availability of places for international applicants.
Why Study Chemical Engineering in Italy A Chemical Engineering Bachelor degree can offer students a combination of academic learning and exposure to Europe's industrial and research environment.

Chemical engineering is a bridge between chemistry, physics, mathematics and engineering. Students learn how to apply these subjects to industrial processes, production systems, materials and energy-related challenges.

Usually students begin with math, physics, general and organic chemistry, and computing. Other topics may include thermodynamics, transport phenomena, reaction kinetics, separation processes, and process control.

Depending on the university and the course structure, students may be involved in laboratory exercises, technical projects, industrial visits or internships. These activities help them relate concepts learned in the classroom to real-world uses in engineering.

Chemical engineering knowledge applies to pharmaceuticals, food processing, energy, chemicals, materials, manufacturing and environmental technology. The career options available to a student depend on his/her skills, experience, language skills and further qualifications.

Graduates with a bachelor's degree may apply to relevant master's programs in chemical engineering, sustainable processes, materials, energy or related disciplines, subject to the admission requirements of each university.

3. Best Chemical Engineering Universities in Italy
Relevant undergraduate study options are available at the following institutions. Please check program names and admission conditions on the official university websites before applying.

The Politecnico di Torino has a degree course in Chemical and Food Engineering. The program integrates fundamentals of chemical engineering and applications in the food industry and industrial production.

The program is taught in Italian, but the first year is also offered in English, according to the university's program information. Students should check the current teaching arrangements and admission-test requirements before applying.

The University of Bologna has a three-year bachelor's degree in Chemical and Biochemical Engineering at its Bologna campus. The program is taught in Italian and combines principles of engineering with chemical and biochemical applications.
The program is published by the university for the academic year 2026/2027, with open access subject to the requirements of the TOLC-I assessment.

Indian students looking into Chemical Engineering universities in Italy should check language requirements, test dates, tuition fees, scholarship conditions and international admission procedures instead of only looking at university rankings.
Generally, Indian students interested in pursuing a Bachelors in Chemical Engineering in Italy must meet the academic and admission criteria of the university they select.
Successful completion of Class 12 or an equivalent secondary-school qualification.
A recognized school leaving certificate that meets the admission regulations of the university.
Depending on the program, a suitable academic background in mathematics, physics and chemistry.
Satisfactory result in the compulsory entrance test or academic assessment.
Proof of knowledge of Italian or English as required by the course.
Completion of international student paperwork and enrollment requirements.

Physics, chemistry and mathematics are closely related to chemical engineering. Universities may require specific subject prerequisites or evaluate a student's academic readiness through an entrance examination. Students must confirm if their Class 12 subjects and qualifications match the norms of the institution they opt for.

There's no percentage that you need to reach for all Italian universities. Eligibility will depend on the university, the course and the assessment process. "A percentage does not guaranty admission. Students should check the official notice of admission."

items: Admission requirements vary by institution and program. Bachelors in Chemical Engineering in Italy students may have to undergo the following steps:

There are some universities that have engineering entrance exams. For instance, Politecnico di Milano uses the TOL engineering entrance exam for its undergraduate Chemical Engineering degree. Politecnico di Torino Chemical and Food Engineering is a capped-access program with a mandatory admission test.

The University of Bologna advertizes its Chemical and Biochemical Engineering course as open access subject to TOLC-I requirements. Students must check the latest official instructions on the test format, deadlines and any applicable alternative procedures.

Many of the undergraduate engineering courses are taught in Italian language. Depending on the university's rules, students may have to prove their proficiency in Italian. For programs taught in English, the university may require an accepted English language qualification or other evidence of proficiency.
Universities assess foreign school qualifications to ensure they meet the entry requirements. Depending on the applicant's situation, other documents, translations or legalization may be required.

sections.title: Cost of Chemical Engineering in Italy

items: The cost of studying in Italy depends on the university, the family income assessment, the fee category, the city and the accommodation choice.
INR estimates are based on an illustrative exchange rate of €1 = ₹108. University fees and actual exchange rates may vary. These are broad planning estimates, not firm fees for each named program.

The actual cost of living will depend on the city, rent, lifestyle and type of accommodation. Milan is more expensive than smaller cities and you will have to budget for initial costs such as a rental deposit, insurance, residence formalities and travel.

International students who meet eligibility criteria can access university scholarships, regional financial aid and other funding opportunities. Availability and eligibility vary by region and institution Students should check deadlines and required income or academic documents early on.
Before you start budgeting, look up the official tuition schedule and scholarship rules for the specific Chemical Engineering Fees in Italy option you are considering.
The general application procedure for Study Chemical Engineering in Italy Bachelors programs is:
Shortlist universities: Compare course content, language of instruction, fees, location and entrance test requirements.
Check eligibility: Ensure your Class 12 marks and subjects meet the university's admission requirements.
Prepare for the entrance exam: If applicable, register for the required exam and follow the university's exam instructions.
Prepare documents: Gather academic records, passport details, photographs, and language certificates as needed.
Submit the application: Apply through the university's official application portal and observe all deadlines.
Complete international-student procedures Complete the relevant pre-enrolment and qualification verification process, including Universitaly procedures where applicable.
Apply for the study visa When the requirements are met, send the visa application together with the required supporting documents to the competent Italian consular authority.
Complete enrollment: Follow the final enrollment instructions from the university and prepare for travel and accommodation.
Admission, pre-enrolment and visa approval are independent decisions. Meeting the university's requirements does not automatically mean you will get a visa.

A degree from an Italian university can serve as a basis for further education and professional development. However, recognition for employment, regulated professional activities or further education is dependent on the relevant institution, employer and applicable regulations.

Students planning to return to India should check any qualification-recognition or professional requirements for their intended career. They also need to know that a bachelor's degree does not automatically provide all the professional licenses and qualifications needed for a particular job.

Graduates can take up entry-level technical positions or pursue postgraduate study after a bachelor's degree. Actual opportunities will be defined by the role, the practical experience, language skills and the local employment requirements.
Chemical Process Engineering: Supporting industrial process operations and optimization.
Production and manufacturing: Helping to monitor and improve production systems.
Quality control: Support for product testing, documentation and process standards.
Pharmaceutical manufacturing: Supporting production processes and quality systems.
Food processing: Industrial production, processing and safety systems
Environmental technology: Support for waste treatment, recycling and resource efficiency projects.
Energy and materials: Investigating industrial applications of fuels, materials and sustainable technologies.
Research and development: Supporting laboratory work and product or process development as per role requirements.

There is not a single salary for all graduates. Earnings vary by employer, city, job responsibilities, experience, language proficiency, and economic conditions. Students should research recent vacancies and graduate employment statistics before estimating their future income.
For many specialist engineering positions, having a related master's degree or further industrial experience can be the key to more advanced technical positions.

Financial evidence and other documentation required for the visa application
Accommodation, insurance or travel-related documents as applicable

faq.question: Can Indian students study Chemical Engineering in Italy after 12th?
faq.answer: Yes, Indian students can apply if they meet the university's academic, entrance-test, language and documentation requirements. Each institution has its own rules for deciding who is eligible.

faq.question: How many years is a Chemical Engineering bachelor in Italy?
faq.answer: The undergraduate courses considered here are typically three-year programs and typically involve 180 ECTS credits. Check the exact structure of the program.

faq.question: Do Chemical Engineering bachelor's programs in Italy have English instruction?
faq.answer: Many of the relevant Bachelor's programs are taught in Italian. Some programs or first-year arrangements may offer English-language teaching, so students should check the exact language of instruction for their chosen course.

faq.question: Tuition Fees for Chemical Engineering in Italy?
faq.answer: For planning purposes, public university tuition can be something like € 900-4000 per year , and living expenses can be something like € 600-1330 per month . Actual costs will differ depending on the university, city, fee category and personal circumstances.

faq.question: Can I do masters after chemical engineering in Italy?
faq.answer: Yes. Graduates can apply for master's programs in chemical engineering, sustainable processes, energy, materials or related areas. Admission is based on the academic and other entry requirements of the master's program.
